headlines: FREE HALLOWEEN TRICK OR TREATING EVENTS ACROSS MIAMI NEIGHBORHOODS
MIAMI HALLOWEEN CANDY STOPS YOU CAN VISIT THIS WEEKEND
BEST SPOTS FOR FREE CANDY ACROSS MIAMI THIS HALLOWEEN
posts.article: Miami families have multiple free community celebrations to gather Halloween candy this weekend. The festivities start Friday, October 30, from 6 to 9:30 p.m. at Shenandoah Park with a trunk-or-treat trail and carnival snacks. On Saturday, October 31, afternoon events include Coral Gables trick-or-treating along Miracle Mile starting at 2 p.m. with a dog costume contest, plus South Miami Safe Streets on Sunset Drive from 4 to 7 p.m. featuring allergy-friendly candy stations. Evening options kick off at 6 p.m. with trunk-or-treat games at Milander Park in Hialeah and Fuller Street festivities in Coconut Grove. Lincoln Road in Miami Beach also hosts costume strolls from 5 p.m. into the night.

headlines: PUBLIX SPENDS 107 MILLION DOLLARS ON TWO MIAMI-DADE PLAZAS
PUBLIX BUYS ITS MIAMI-DADE SHOPPING PLAZAS
SUPERMARKET GIANT BECOMES THE LANDLORD ACROSS MIAMI-DADE CENTERS
posts.article: Lakeland-based Publix is making major real estate moves across Miami-Dade by taking ownership of the shopping centers where it operates. During October, the grocery giant invested $107 million to purchase two retail centers in the county. The newly acquired commercial plazas are located near Miami International Airport and in southwest Miami-Dade. With these purchases, the supermarket giant is shifting its position from a retail tenant into a commercial landlord. Publix now owns the shopping plazas where its own supermarkets anchor the retail mix.
